heading: INT. ROYAL OPERA HOUSE - BACKSTAGE - NIGHT (1923)

units.text: INT. ROYAL OPERA HOUSE - BACKSTAGE - NIGHT (1923)
Ropes, flats, a smell of greasepaint.
Gaslight hisses in sconces.
Beyond the curtain, an orchestra tunes.
PRIMA DONNA ELVIRA CASTELLANI (40s, glittering gown, feathered headdress) sweeps down the corridor, flanked by her dresser, MAUD PRIMROSE (30s, pins in her mouth).
Around the corner steps her rival, BARONESS LUDMILLA ROSENKRANZ (40s, ermine stole), and the two women stop face to face.
The stage manager, CORNELIUS BLYTHE (50s, pince-nez), hurries between them.
Ladies, please. Curtain in five.
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: She is in my dressing room.
units.name: ELVIRA

units.text: Your dressing room was always mine.
units.name: LUDMILLA

units.text: She stole my feather.
units.name: ELVIRA

units.text: She wore it badly.
units.name: LUDMILLA

units.text: Maud spits out the pins.
Elvira lunges; Ludmilla shoves; the two women tangle, pulling at each other's headdresses, and Cornelius is jostled between them.
Mr. Blythe! The Prince has arrived!
units.name: TANNOY

units.text: Not now!
units.name: CORNELIUS

units.text: He asks for the leading lady!
units.name: TANNOY

units.text: She can be the leading lady --
units.name: ELVIRA

units.text: -- over my dead body!
units.name: LUDMILLA

units.text: The two freeze, glaring.
Maud steps between them with the dress pins in her hand.
Ladies. The Prince.
units.name: MAUD

units.text: They both smooth their gowns.
Elvira smiles.
Ludmilla smiles.
Both sweep toward the curtain together.
